title: Japan Diet Proceedings Search (Kokkai)
description: Enter at least one search condition, such as keywords, a meeting name, a speaker, or a meeting date.

mode.title: Result type
mode.description: Speech returns individual matching speeches with text. Meeting list returns matching meetings with links to matching speeches when available. Full meeting returns matching meetings with the text of all speeches in each meeting.

any.title: Keywords
any.description: Search for words in the proceedings. Separate words with spaces to require all words (AND). For example, 生成AI means generative AI.

speaker.title: Speaker name
speaker.description: Search for a speaker by name. Separate terms with spaces to match any of them (OR).

nameOfHouse.title: House
nameOfHouse.description: Limit the search to the House of Representatives, House of Councillors, or joint proceedings.

nameOfMeeting.title: Meeting name
nameOfMeeting.description: Search by plenary or committee name. Separate terms with spaces to match any of them (OR).

speakerGroup.title: Speaker's parliamentary group
speakerGroup.description: Search for part of the official name of the speaker's parliamentary group.

speakerPosition.title: Speaker's position
speakerPosition.description: Search for part of the speaker's title or position as recorded in the proceedings.

speakerRole.title: Speaker's role
speakerRole.description: Limit the search to witnesses, invited experts, or public hearing speakers.

from.title: Meeting date from
from.description: Include meetings on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

until.title: Meeting date until
until.description: Include meetings on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

sessionFrom.title: First Diet session
sessionFrom.description: Start of the inclusive session range. If only one bound is set, search only that session.

sessionTo.title: Last Diet session
sessionTo.description: End of the inclusive session range. If only one bound is set, search only that session.

searchRange.title: Keyword search section
searchRange.description: Search the opening, main proceedings, or both. Applies when keywords are provided. The API searches both sections by default.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of speeches or meetings to write to the dataset.

requestIntervalSecs.title: Seconds between requests
requestIntervalSecs.description: Seconds to wait after an API response. Retries may wait longer.

onlyNew.title: Only new results
onlyNew.description: Remember successfully saved results and skip them on later runs.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Use a separate key for each monitored search. Use 1 to 50 letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.
